newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINA'S EDENOR WANTS TO DOUBLE BOND PROGRAM.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINA'S EDENOR WANTS TO DOUBLE BOND PROGRAM.

text.p: The board of directors at Argentina's electricity distribution company Edenor SA said Wednesday it had proposed to raise the amount of the company's negotiable bond program to $600 million from $300 million.

In a statement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange, the company said it wanted to double its bond program to take advantage of favorable local and international bond market conditions to re-finance current liabilities more cheaply.
Edenor said it would hold a shareholders' meeting on September 5 to win approval for the increase.
